entries.text: python -m benchbox.utils.host_lock admit and run --admit refuse to start heavy jobs while the host is under memory pressure or low on disk, with itemized readings; tune with BENCHBOX_HEAVY_ADMIT_MIN_GIB, BENCHBOX_HEAVY_MIN_LEVEL, BENCHBOX_HEAVY_MIN_FREE_DISK_GIB and BENCHBOX_HEAVY_ADMIT=force.
